note: Regression for hif-backend#40, which emitted a run-once process as `always` instead of `initial`. Both spellings are legal Verilog around the same body, so the round trip cannot see the difference; the design is simulated because a replayed body returns rst_n to 0 in the instant it reaches 1, and the counter it gates never leaves zero. The reset is released at 12 ns, off the clock grid, so the trace pins the one-shot release rather than a race between the initial block and the clocked process.
